name: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance — Reptile Ending
notes: In-game ending accessed through the MKWarehouse preservation mirror. It portrays energy from a dragon embryo or egg striking and transforming Reptile as the Dragon King returns. This is ending evidence; later Armageddon biographies confirm Reptile as Onaga's host body, but this record alone does not make every egg-energy detail canonical.
